arr_bridge.methodology: Monthly ARR movements derived from fact_subscription_month using SQL window functions (LAG). New logo = customer whose first_active_month (MIN snapshot_month with arr_usd > 0) equals the current snapshot_month within FY2025. Reactivation = customer with prior positive ARR history who returned to positive ARR after reaching zero; no such customers identified in FY2025. Expansion = positive ARR increase for already-active customer vs immediately preceding month. Contraction = ARR decrease for customer remaining active. Churn = transition from positive to zero ARR. Bridge reconciles to zero difference.

retention.methodology: Starting cohort: 180 customers with positive ARR at 2024-12-01 (immediately preceding fiscal year-end snapshot). NRR: ending ARR attributable to starting cohort at 2025-12-01 divided by starting ARR. GRR: retained ARR capped at opening ARR per customer (no expansion benefit) divided by starting ARR. Logo churn: count of starting-cohort customers who reached zero ARR in any month during Jan-Dec 2025 divided by starting cohort count. Reactivation treatment: no reactivations identified in FY2025; methodology would preserve churn event and classify return as reactivation separately. All calculations performed in SQL using full monthly history.

recurring_revenue.methodology: Management-tagged recurring revenue uses fact_invoice_line.revenue_type = 'Recurring'. Independent restatement uses dim_product.delivery_model: 'Subscription' delivery model classified as independently recurring; 'One-time' delivery model classified as independently one-time. No 'Perpetual' or ambiguous delivery model products found in FY2025 revenue lines. Reclassified amount represents revenue tagged 'Recurring' by management but associated with non-Subscription delivery model products per dim_product. The independent restatement yields 87.40% recurring vs management claim of 98.34%, a difference of 10.94 percentage points. The gap is driven by Professional Services and other non-subscription product lines tagged as Recurring in the source system.

collections_quality.dso_methodology: PRIMARY METHOD: Period-end reconstructed AR / same-quarter revenue * calendar days. Q4 2025 (2025-10-01 to 2025-12-31): Outstanding AR at 2025-12-31 = invoices issued on or before 2025-12-31 minus collections received on or before 2025-12-31. Revenue = sum of invoice line amounts for Q4 2025. Calendar days = 92. DSO = 6,236,836.60 / 9,658,744.64 * 92 = 59.41 days.
collections_quality.weighted_collection_days_methodology: Weighted average of days_outstanding field from fact_collection, weighted by amount_paid_usd, for payments received during FY2025 (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31). This is a secondary collection-timing metric and is NOT equivalent to reconstructed period-end DSO.

customer_tenure.population: Top 10 customers by FY2025 revenue (fact_invoice_line joined to fact_invoice, ranked by sum of line_amount_usd). Tenure calculated as DATEDIFF('2025-12-31', first_order_date) / 365.25.
customer_tenure.data_quality_note: CUST-0006 (rank 7) has a first_order_date of 2025-03-01, yielding tenure of 0.84 years. This customer entered the top 10 in FY2025 and materially reduces the average. Excluding this customer, average tenure for remaining 9 = approximately 6.12 years.

metric_evidence.query: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' THEN 'FY2023' WHEN CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' THEN 'FY2024' WHEN CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' THEN 'FY2025' END AS fiscal_year, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT fi.invoice_id) AS invoice_count, COUNT(DISTINCT fi.customer_id) AS customer_count, COUNT(fil.invoice_line_id) AS line_count FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id WHERE CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
metric_evidence.methodology: Revenue aggregated at invoice-line grain (fact_invoice_line.line_amount_usd) joined to fact_invoice for date. Line-level grain prevents double-counting of invoice header totals.

metric_evidence.query: WITH annual AS (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' THEN 'FY2023' WHEN CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' THEN 'FY2025' END AS fiscal_year, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id WHERE CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' OR CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1), pivoted AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2023' THEN total_revenue END) AS fy2023_rev, MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025' THEN total_revenue END) AS fy2025_rev FROM annual) SELECT fy2023_rev, fy2025_rev, 2 AS num_periods, ROUND((POWER(fy2025_rev / fy2023_rev, 1.0/2) - 1) * 100, 4) AS cagr_pct FROM pivoted
metric_evidence.methodology: CAGR = (end_value/start_value)^(1/n) - 1 where n=2 periods. Calculated entirely in SQL using POWER function.

metric_evidence.query: WITH fy2025_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id WHERE CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY fi.customer_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(customer_revenue) AS total_rev FROM fy2025_rev), ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, customer_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY customer_revenue DESC) AS rnk FROM fy2025_rev) SELECT t.total_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rnk = 1 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS top1_rev, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rnk = 1 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END) / t.total_rev * 100, 4) AS top1_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rnk <= 3 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS top3_rev, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rnk <= 3 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END) / t.total_rev * 100, 4) AS top3_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rnk <= 5 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS top5_rev, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rnk <= 5 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END) / t.total_rev * 100, 4) AS top5_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rnk <= 10 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS top10_rev, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rnk <= 10 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END) / t.total_rev * 100, 4) AS top10_pct FROM ranked r CROSS JOIN total t GROUP BY t.total_rev
metric_evidence.methodology: Customer revenue ranked by ROW_NUMBER descending. Top-N revenue and percentages calculated in SQL. Reconciliation: sum of all customer revenues equals total period revenue.

metric_evidence.query: WITH monthly_arr AS (SELECT customer_id, snapshot_month, arr_usd, LAG(arr_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS prev_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month), first_positive AS (SELECT customer_id, MIN(snapshot_month) AS first_active_month FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE arr_usd > 0 GROUP BY customer_id), movements AS (SELECT m.customer_id, m.snapshot_month, m.arr_usd, COALESCE(m.prev_arr, 0) AS prev_arr_safe, fp.first_active_month, CASE WHEN m.arr_usd > 0 AND fp.first_active_month = m.snapshot_month THEN 'new_logo' WHEN COALESCE(m.prev_arr, 0) = 0 AND m.arr_usd > 0 AND fp.first_active_month < m.snapshot_month THEN 'reactivation' WHEN COALESCE(m.prev_arr, 0) > 0 AND m.arr_usd > COALESCE(m.prev_arr, 0) THEN 'expansion' WHEN COALESCE(m.prev_arr, 0) > 0 AND m.arr_usd > 0 AND m.arr_usd < COALESCE(m.prev_arr, 0) THEN 'contraction' WHEN COALESCE(m.prev_arr, 0) > 0 AND m.arr_usd = 0 THEN 'churn' ELSE 'flat' END AS movement_type, CASE WHEN m.arr_usd > 0 AND fp.first_active_month = m.snapshot_month THEN m.arr_usd WHEN COALESCE(m.prev_arr, 0) = 0 AND m.arr_usd > 0 AND fp.first_active_month < m.snapshot_month THEN m.arr_usd WHEN COALESCE(m.prev_arr, 0) > 0 AND m.arr_usd > COALESCE(m.prev_arr, 0) THEN m.arr_usd - COALESCE(m.prev_arr, 0) WHEN COALESCE(m.prev_arr, 0) > 0 AND m.arr_usd > 0 AND m.arr_usd < COALESCE(m.prev_arr, 0) THEN COALESCE(m.prev_arr, 0) - m.arr_usd WHEN COALESCE(m.prev_arr, 0) > 0 AND m.arr_usd = 0 THEN COALESCE(m.prev_arr, 0) ELSE 0 END AS movement_amount FROM monthly_arr m JOIN first_positive fp ON m.customer_id = fp.customer_id WHERE m.snapshot_month > '2024-12-01' AND m.snapshot_month <= '2025-12-01'), bridge AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type = 'new_logo' THEN movement_amount ELSE 0 END) AS new_logo_arr, SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type = 'expansion' THEN movement_amount ELSE 0 END) AS expansion_arr, SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type = 'contraction' THEN movement_amount ELSE 0 END) AS contraction_arr, SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type = 'churn' THEN movement_amount ELSE 0 END) AS churned_arr, SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type = 'reactivation' THEN movement_amount ELSE 0 END) AS reactivation_arr, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN movement_type = 'new_logo' THEN customer_id END) AS new_logo_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN movement_type = 'churn' THEN customer_id END) AS churned_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN movement_type = 'reactivation' THEN customer_id END) AS reactivation_count FROM movements), opening AS (SELECT SUM(arr_usd) AS opening_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2024-12-01'), closing AS (SELECT SUM(arr_usd) AS closing_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2025-12-01') SELECT o.opening_arr, b.new_logo_arr, b.new_logo_count, b.expansion_arr, b.contraction_arr, b.churned_arr, b.churned_count, b.reactivation_arr, b.reactivation_count, c.closing_arr, ROUND((o.opening_arr + b.new_logo_arr + b.expansion_arr - b.contraction_arr - b.churned_arr + b.reactivation_arr) - c.closing_arr, 4) AS reconciliation_diff FROM bridge b CROSS JOIN opening o CROSS JOIN closing c
metric_evidence.methodology: Monthly ARR movements classified using LAG window function. New logo = customer whose MIN(snapshot_month with arr_usd>0) equals current snapshot_month. Reactivation = prior positive ARR history, returned after zero. Bridge reconciles to zero difference.

metric_evidence.query: NRR: WITH opening_cohort AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd AS opening_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2024-12-01' AND arr_usd > 0), closing_arr AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd AS closing_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2025-12-01'), cohort_closing AS (SELECT oc.customer_id, oc.opening_arr, COALESCE(ca.closing_arr, 0) AS closing_arr FROM opening_cohort oc LEFT JOIN closing_arr ca ON oc.customer_id = ca.customer_id) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS starting_cohort_count, SUM(opening_arr) AS starting_arr, SUM(closing_arr) AS ending_arr_cohort, ROUND(SUM(closing_arr) / SUM(opening_arr) * 100, 4) AS nrr_pct FROM cohort_closing | GRR: same cohort with LEAST(closing_arr, opening_arr) per customer | Logo Churn: opening cohort customers with arr_usd=0 in any month Jan-Dec 2025
metric_evidence.methodology: Opening cohort = 180 customers with positive ARR at 2024-12-01 (immediately preceding fiscal year-end). NRR includes expansion. GRR caps each customer's closing ARR at opening ARR. Logo churn counts intra-period churn events using monthly data.

metric_evidence.query: Management-tagged: SELECT fil.revenue_type, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS revenue, t.total_rev, ROUND(fil_revenue/t.total_rev*100,4) AS pct FROM fact_invoice_line fil JOIN fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id=fi.invoice_id WHERE invoice_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY revenue_type | Independent: WITH fy2025 AS (SELECT fil.invoice_line_id, fil.line_amount_usd, p.delivery_model, CASE WHEN p.delivery_model='Subscription' THEN 'independently_recurring' WHEN p.delivery_model='One-time' THEN 'independently_one_time' ELSE 'ambiguous' END AS independent_classification FROM fact_invoice_line fil JOIN fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id=fi.invoice_id JOIN dim_product p ON fil.product_id=p.product_id WHERE invoice_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31') SELECT independent_classification, SUM(line_amount_usd), COUNT(*), total_rev, ROUND(revenue/total_rev*100,4) FROM fy2025 GROUP BY independent_classification
metric_evidence.methodology: Management classification uses fact_invoice_line.revenue_type. Independent restatement uses dim_product.delivery_model: Subscription=recurring, One-time=non-recurring. No Perpetual or ambiguous delivery model products found in FY2025 lines.

metric_evidence.query: WITH quarters AS (SELECT '2025-Q4' AS qtr, '2025-10-01' AS qtr_start, '2025-12-31' AS qtr_end, 92 AS cal_days ...), invoices_to_date AS (SELECT q.qtr, fi.invoice_id, fi.invoice_amount_usd FROM quarters q JOIN fact_invoice fi ON CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) <= CAST(q.qtr_end AS DATE)), collections_to_date AS (SELECT q.qtr, fc.invoice_id, SUM(fc.amount_paid_usd) AS collected FROM quarters q JOIN fact_collection fc ON CAST(fc.payment_date AS DATE) <= CAST(q.qtr_end AS DATE) GROUP BY q.qtr, fc.invoice_id), ar_at_period_end AS (SELECT i.qtr, SUM(i.invoice_amount_usd - COALESCE(c.collected,0)) AS outstanding_ar FROM invoices_to_date i LEFT JOIN collections_to_date c ON i.qtr=c.qtr AND i.invoice_id=c.invoice_id GROUP BY i.qtr), qtr_revenue AS (SELECT q.qtr, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS qtr_rev FROM quarters q JOIN fact_invoice fi ON invoice_date BETWEEN qtr_start AND qtr_end JOIN fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id=fil.invoice_id GROUP BY q.qtr) SELECT ar.qtr, ar.outstanding_ar, qr.qtr_rev, ar.cal_days, ROUND(ar.outstanding_ar/qr.qtr_rev*ar.cal_days,2) AS dso_days FROM ar_at_period_end ar JOIN qtr_revenue qr ON ar.qtr=qr.qtr ORDER BY ar.qtr
metric_evidence.methodology: Period-end AR reconstructed from invoice history minus collections received on or before period end. DSO = outstanding_AR / same_period_revenue * calendar_days. Future payments not applied to historical balances. Unpaid invoices retained in AR.

metric_evidence.query: Earliest (2023-Q1) vs latest (2025-Q4) DSO comparison using same reconstruction methodology as SQL-EV-007. Absolute change and percentage change calculated in SQL.
metric_evidence.methodology: Same DSO formula applied consistently to earliest and latest comparable quarters. Absolute change = 59.41 - 15.25 = 44.16 days. Percentage change = 289.57%.

metric_evidence.metric: DSO by Customer Tier (Segment) at Q4 2025
metric_evidence.query: WITH customer_tiers AS (SELECT customer_id, segment FROM dim_customer), invoices_to_date AS (SELECT fi.invoice_id, fi.customer_id, fi.invoice_amount_usd FROM fact_invoice fi WHERE CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) <= '2025-12-31'), collections_to_date AS (SELECT fc.invoice_id, SUM(fc.amount_paid_usd) AS collected FROM fact_collection fc WHERE CAST(fc.payment_date AS DATE) <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY fc.invoice_id), customer_ar AS (SELECT i.customer_id, SUM(i.invoice_amount_usd - COALESCE(c.collected,0)) AS outstanding_ar FROM invoices_to_date i LEFT JOIN collections_to_date c ON i.invoice_id=c.invoice_id GROUP BY i.customer_id), qtr_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS qtr_revenue FROM fact_invoice_line fil JOIN fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id=fi.invoice_id WHERE invoice_date BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY fi.customer_id) SELECT ct.segment, COUNT(DISTINCT ct.customer_id), SUM(COALESCE(ca.outstanding_ar,0)), SUM(COALESCE(qr.qtr_revenue,0)), ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(ca.outstanding_ar,0))/NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(qr.qtr_revenue,0)),0)*92,2) AS dso_days FROM customer_tiers ct LEFT JOIN customer_ar ca ON ct.customer_id=ca.customer_id LEFT JOIN qtr_rev qr ON ct.customer_id=qr.customer_id GROUP BY ct.segment
metric_evidence.methodology: Same period-end AR reconstruction methodology. Segment from dim_customer. Enterprise DSO materially higher (72.64 days) than Mid-Market (17.74) and SMB (21.61).

metric_evidence.metric: DSO Top Customer Cohorts at Q4 2025
metric_evidence.query: Customers ranked by FY2025 revenue. AR reconstructed at 2025-12-31 using same methodology as SQL-EV-007. DSO calculated per cohort using Q4 2025 revenue and 92 calendar days.
metric_evidence.methodology: Top-N cohorts defined by FY2025 revenue rank. DSO = cohort_outstanding_AR / cohort_Q4_revenue * 92. Top-1 customer DSO = 23.28 days; remaining customers DSO = 4.15 days.

metric_evidence.query: WITH fy2025_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue FROM fact_invoice_line fil JOIN fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id=fi.invoice_id WHERE invoice_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY fi.customer_id), ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, customer_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY customer_revenue DESC) AS rnk FROM fy2025_rev), top10 AS (SELECT r.customer_id FROM ranked r WHERE r.rnk<=10), tenure_calc AS (SELECT t.customer_id, dc.first_order_date, ROUND(DATEDIFF('2025-12-31', CAST(dc.first_order_date AS DATE))/365.25,4) AS tenure_years FROM top10 t JOIN dim_customer dc ON t.customer_id=dc.customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*), ROUND(AVG(tenure_years),4), MIN(tenure_years), MAX(tenure_years) FROM tenure_calc
metric_evidence.methodology: Tenure = DATEDIFF('2025-12-31', first_order_date) / 365.25. Average calculated in SQL.

metric_evidence.query: SELECT fst.customer_id, fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS total_tickets, SUM(CASE WHEN fst.severity IN ('S1','S2') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_sev_tickets, SUM(CASE WHEN fst.resolution_hours IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unresolved_tickets, ROUND(AVG(fst.csat_score),4) AS avg_csat, ROUND(AVG(fst.resolution_hours),4) AS avg_resolution_hours FROM fact_support_ticket fst WHERE customer_id IN (top 5 by FY2025 revenue) AND opened_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY customer_id, fiscal_year ORDER BY customer_id, fiscal_year
metric_evidence.methodology: High severity = S1 or S2. Unresolved = resolution_hours IS NULL. CSAT and resolution hours averaged in SQL. Top 5 customers identified dynamically from FY2025 revenue ranking.

issues.description: fact_collection has 96 records with null payment_date. These represent unpaid invoices at the analysis date. They are correctly retained in period-end AR calculations and not silently excluded.

dim_customer.parent_customer_id is null for 213 of 214 customers. Only 1 non-null parent_customer_id exists. Parent-group economic consolidation is not reliably applicable. All concentration and retention metrics calculated at individual customer level.

CUST-0006 (rank 7 by FY2025 revenue, $1.2M) has first_order_date of 2025-03-01, yielding tenure of 0.84 years. This customer entered the top 10 in FY2025 and materially reduces the average top-10 tenure from approximately 6.12 years (excluding CUST-0006) to 5.60 years (including CUST-0006).

CUST-0002 (rank 2 by FY2025 revenue, $5.26M) shows material customer health deterioration in FY2025: ticket volume increased from 22 (FY2024) to 69 (FY2025), high-severity (S1/S2) tickets increased from 3 to 37, and average CSAT declined from 4.05 (FY2023) to 2.39 (FY2025). This is a quantitative signal for downstream contract and risk agents.

DSO has increased materially from 15.25 days (2023-Q1) to 59.41 days (2025-Q4), a 289.57% increase. The management claim of ~45 days was approximately matched in 2024-Q4 (45.60 days) but the most recent quarter (2025-Q4) is 59.41 days, indicating the claim of stability is not supported by the most recent data.

AR concentration is highly skewed: top-1 customer accounts for 47.57% of total outstanding AR ($2.97M of $6.24M). Top-3 customers account for 85.33% of total AR. Enterprise segment DSO is 72.64 days vs 17.74 days for Mid-Market.

ARR bridge reconciliation note: the initial bridge query (using prev_arr IS NULL logic) produced a reconciliation gap of -$2,378,027.46. This was resolved by correcting the new-logo classification logic to use first_active_month = snapshot_month as the definitive new-logo criterion. The corrected bridge reconciles to zero. The 20 new logos in FY2025 account for $2,378,027.46 of new ARR.
